description: This file is a markdown document that provides documentation and example usage for the 'Coverage' class in the Playwright library, specifically for JavaScript and CSS coverage analysis. It describes class methods, options, and usage patterns.

classes.name: Coverage
classes.description: A class that gathers coverage information for JavaScript and CSS executed on a page, including methods to start and stop coverage collection for JS and CSS.

methods.name: Coverage.startCSSCoverage
methods.description: Starts CSS coverage collection with optional reset on navigation.

methods.name: Coverage.startJSCoverage
methods.description: Starts JavaScript coverage collection with options for reporting anonymous scripts and reset on navigation.

methods.name: Coverage.stopCSSCoverage
methods.description: Stops CSS coverage collection and returns coverage reports for stylesheets.

methods.name: Coverage.stopJSCoverage
methods.description: Stops JavaScript coverage collection and returns coverage reports for scripts.
